hronaut.http_headers_helper: "/bin/sh" -c "t=\$( { cd ~/Library/Application\ Support/hronaut || cd ~/.config/hronaut; } 2>/dev/null && LC_ALL=C tr -d '\357\273\277[:space:]' 2>/dev/null < mcp-token ); case \$t in *[!ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-]*) t= ;; esac; if [ \${#t} -ge 32 ]; then printf '{\042Authorization\042:\042Bearer %s\042}' \$t; else printf '{}'; fi" || powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "try { $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText(($env:APPDATA + '\hronaut\mcp-token')).Trim() } catch { $t = '' }; if ($t -cmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}\z') { [Console]::Out.Write('{' + [char]34 + 'Authorization' + [char]34 + ':' + [char]34 + 'Bearer ' + $t + [char]34 + '}') } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') }"
